# Learn Prompting (O'zbekcha)

> Learn Prompting is a free, open-source course teaching how to communicate effectively with AI systems (prompt engineering). This is the Uzbek-language ("O'zbekcha nashr") edition, maintained by HumblebeeAI, adapted from the original English project at learnprompting.org. Content covers prompting basics, intermediate and advanced techniques, applied/basic applications, image prompting, prompt hacking & defense, reliability, trainable prompts, and tooling.

## Docs: Basics
- [Introduction to AI](https://learnprompting.uz/docs/basics/intro): What large language models are and how they work.
- [Prompt Engineering](https://learnprompting.uz/docs/basics/prompt_engineering): What prompt engineering is and why it matters.
- [Prompting With ChatGPT](https://learnprompting.uz/docs/basics/prompting): Core prompting concepts and interacting with ChatGPT.
- [Giving Instructions](https://learnprompting.uz/docs/basics/instructions): Writing effective instructions for LLMs.
- [Assigning Roles](https://learnprompting.uz/docs/basics/roles): Using role prompting to steer model behavior.
- [Chatbots](https://learnprompting.uz/docs/basics/chatbot_basics): Basics of chatbot interaction design.
- [Combining Techniques](https://learnprompting.uz/docs/basics/combining_techniques): Mixing multiple prompting techniques together.
- [LLM Settings](https://learnprompting.uz/docs/basics/configuration_hyperparameters): Configuring temperature, top-p, and other hyperparameters.
- [Formalizing Prompts](https://learnprompting.uz/docs/basics/formalizing): A structured framework for describing prompts.
- [The Learn Prompting Method](https://learnprompting.uz/docs/basics/learn_prompting_method): The course's approach to teaching prompt engineering.
- [OpenAI Playground](https://learnprompting.uz/docs/basics/openai_playground): Using OpenAI's Playground tool.
- [Pitfalls of LLMs](https://learnprompting.uz/docs/basics/pitfalls): Common failure modes and limitations of LLMs.
- [Priming Chatbots](https://learnprompting.uz/docs/basics/priming_prompt): Setting up context before the main prompt.
- [Starting Your Journey](https://learnprompting.uz/docs/basics/starting_your_journey): Where to begin learning prompt engineering.
- [Understanding AI Minds](https://learnprompting.uz/docs/basics/world): How to reason about what an LLM "knows".
- [Learn Prompting Embeds](https://learnprompting.uz/docs/basics/embeds): Embedding interactive course content.

## Docs: Intermediate Techniques
- [Chain of Thought Prompting](https://learnprompting.uz/docs/intermediate/chain_of_thought): Step-by-step reasoning prompts.
- [Zero Shot Chain of Thought](https://learnprompting.uz/docs/intermediate/zero_shot_cot): Zero-shot chain-of-thought prompting.
- [Least to Most Prompting](https://learnprompting.uz/docs/intermediate/least_to_most): Decomposing complex problems into subproblems.
- [Self-Consistency](https://learnprompting.uz/docs/intermediate/self_consistency): Improving answer reliability via sampling.
- [Generated Knowledge](https://learnprompting.uz/docs/intermediate/generated_knowledge): Generating context before answering.
- [What's in a Prompt?](https://learnprompting.uz/docs/intermediate/whats_in_a_prompt): Breaking down the components of a prompt.
- [Revisiting Roles](https://learnprompting.uz/docs/intermediate/revisiting_roles): Advanced role-prompting patterns.
- [Dealing With Long Form Content](https://learnprompting.uz/docs/intermediate/long_form_content): Techniques for long documents and context windows.

## Docs: Advanced Applications
- [Introduction](https://learnprompting.uz/docs/advanced_applications/overview): Advanced prompting application patterns.
- [LLMs that Reason and Act (ReAct)](https://learnprompting.uz/docs/advanced_applications/react): Reasoning + acting agent pattern.
- [LLMs Using Tools (MRKL)](https://learnprompting.uz/docs/advanced_applications/mrkl): Modular reasoning and tool use.
- [Code as Reasoning (PAL)](https://learnprompting.uz/docs/advanced_applications/pal): Program-aided language models.

## Docs: Applied Prompting
- [Introduction](https://learnprompting.uz/docs/applied_prompting/overview): Applied, real-world prompting projects.
- [Build ChatGPT from GPT-3](https://learnprompting.uz/docs/applied_prompting/build_chatgpt): Building a ChatGPT-like assistant from a base model.
- [Chatbot + Knowledge Base](https://learnprompting.uz/docs/applied_prompting/build_chatbot_from_kb): Building a knowledge-base-grounded chatbot.
- [Multiple Choice Questions](https://learnprompting.uz/docs/applied_prompting/mc_tutorial): Prompting LLMs to answer multiple-choice questions.
- [Solve Discussion Questions](https://learnprompting.uz/docs/applied_prompting/short_response): Prompting for short discussion-style answers.

## Docs: Basic Applications
- [Introduction](https://learnprompting.uz/docs/basic_applications/introduction): Everyday practical use cases for prompting.
- [Coding Assistance](https://learnprompting.uz/docs/basic_applications/coding_assistance): Using AI for coding assistance.
- [Summarizing Text](https://learnprompting.uz/docs/basic_applications/summarize): Summarization prompts.
- [Writing An Email](https://learnprompting.uz/docs/basic_applications/writing_emails): Writing emails with AI.
- [Blogs](https://learnprompting.uz/docs/basic_applications/blog_generation): Generating blog content with AI.
- [Contracts](https://learnprompting.uz/docs/basic_applications/contracts): Drafting and reviewing contracts with AI.
- [Digital Marketing](https://learnprompting.uz/docs/basic_applications/digital_marketing): AI for marketing copy and campaigns.
- [Finding Emojis](https://learnprompting.uz/docs/basic_applications/emojis): Using AI to find relevant emojis.
- [Study Buddy](https://learnprompting.uz/docs/basic_applications/study_tool): AI as a study and learning aid.
- [Structuring Data](https://learnprompting.uz/docs/basic_applications/table_generation): Generating tables and structured data.
- [Different Writing Styles](https://learnprompting.uz/docs/basic_applications/writing_in_diff_voices): Writing in different tones and voices.
- [Zapier for Emails](https://learnprompting.uz/docs/basic_applications/zapier_for_emails): Automating email workflows with Zapier and AI.

## Docs: Image Prompting
- [Introduction](https://learnprompting.uz/docs/image_prompting/intro): Basics of prompting image generation models.
- [Midjourney](https://learnprompting.uz/docs/image_prompting/midjourney): Midjourney-specific prompting techniques.
- [Shot Type](https://learnprompting.uz/docs/image_prompting/shot_type): Controlling camera framing in prompts.
- [Style Modifiers](https://learnprompting.uz/docs/image_prompting/style_modifiers): Adjusting visual style via prompts.
- [Quality Boosters](https://learnprompting.uz/docs/image_prompting/quality_boosters): Keywords that improve generation quality.
- [Weighted Terms](https://learnprompting.uz/docs/image_prompting/weighted_terms): Weighting specific terms in image prompts.
- [Repetition](https://learnprompting.uz/docs/image_prompting/repetition): Using repetition to emphasize prompt elements.
- [Fix Deformed Generations](https://learnprompting.uz/docs/image_prompting/fix_deformed_generations): Correcting common generation artifacts.
- [Resources](https://learnprompting.uz/docs/image_prompting/resources): Further image-prompting resources.

## Docs: Prompt Hacking & Security
- [Introduction](https://learnprompting.uz/docs/prompt_hacking/intro): Overview of prompt hacking / adversarial prompting.
- [Prompt Injection](https://learnprompting.uz/docs/prompt_hacking/injection): Prompt injection attacks.
- [Jailbreaking](https://learnprompting.uz/docs/prompt_hacking/jailbreaking): LLM jailbreak techniques.
- [Prompt Leaking](https://learnprompting.uz/docs/prompt_hacking/leaking): Extracting hidden system prompts.
- [Offensive Measures: Overview](https://learnprompting.uz/docs/prompt_hacking/offensive_measures/overview): Overview of offensive prompt-hacking techniques.
- [Payload Splitting](https://learnprompting.uz/docs/prompt_hacking/offensive_measures/payload_splitting): Splitting malicious payloads across a prompt.
- [Obfuscation / Token Smuggling](https://learnprompting.uz/docs/prompt_hacking/offensive_measures/obfuscation): Evading filters via obfuscated tokens.
- [Indirect Injection](https://learnprompting.uz/docs/prompt_hacking/offensive_measures/indirect_injection): Injection via untrusted third-party content.
- [Recursive Injection](https://learnprompting.uz/docs/prompt_hacking/offensive_measures/recursive_attack): Recursive prompt-injection attacks.
- [Code Injection](https://learnprompting.uz/docs/prompt_hacking/offensive_measures/code_injection): Injecting executable code via prompts.
- [Virtualization](https://learnprompting.uz/docs/prompt_hacking/offensive_measures/virtualization): Roleplay-based jailbreak framing.
- [Defined Dictionary Attack](https://learnprompting.uz/docs/prompt_hacking/offensive_measures/defined_dictionary): Dictionary-substitution based attacks.
- [Defensive Measures: Overview](https://learnprompting.uz/docs/prompt_hacking/defensive_measures/overview): Overview of defenses against prompt attacks.
- [Filtering](https://learnprompting.uz/docs/prompt_hacking/defensive_measures/filtering): Filtering malicious input/output.
- [Instruction Defense](https://learnprompting.uz/docs/prompt_hacking/defensive_measures/instruction): Hardening instructions against override attempts.
- [Post-Prompting](https://learnprompting.uz/docs/prompt_hacking/defensive_measures/post_prompting): Placing instructions after user input.
- [Random Sequence Enclosure](https://learnprompting.uz/docs/prompt_hacking/defensive_measures/random_sequence): Enclosing input with random sequences.
- [Sandwich Defense](https://learnprompting.uz/docs/prompt_hacking/defensive_measures/sandwich_defense): Sandwiching user input between instructions.
- [XML Tagging](https://learnprompting.uz/docs/prompt_hacking/defensive_measures/xml_tagging): Using XML tags to delimit trusted content.
- [Separate LLM Evaluation](https://learnprompting.uz/docs/prompt_hacking/defensive_measures/llm_eval): Using a second LLM to evaluate outputs.
- [Other Approaches](https://learnprompting.uz/docs/prompt_hacking/defensive_measures/other): Additional defensive techniques.

## Docs: Reliability
- [Introduction](https://learnprompting.uz/docs/reliability/intro): Improving the reliability of LLM outputs.
- [Calibrating LLMs](https://learnprompting.uz/docs/reliability/calibration): Calibrating model confidence.
- [Prompt Debiasing](https://learnprompting.uz/docs/reliability/debiasing): Reducing bias in model outputs.
- [Prompt Ensembling](https://learnprompting.uz/docs/reliability/ensembling): Combining multiple prompts/outputs.
- [LLM Self Evaluation](https://learnprompting.uz/docs/reliability/lm_self_eval): Having a model evaluate its own output.
- [Math](https://learnprompting.uz/docs/reliability/math): Improving LLM performance on math problems.

## Docs: Trainable Prompts
- [Interpretable Soft Prompts](https://learnprompting.uz/docs/trainable/discretized): Discrete trainable prompt tokens.
- [Soft Prompts](https://learnprompting.uz/docs/trainable/soft_prompting): Continuous/soft trainable prompts.
